text: Program Description 1. Major Training Objectives Editor Note: Students are mainly engage in project design, research and development, network operation, equipment manufacturing, and technical management in the field of info-communications after graduation. This program aims to cultivate high-quality personnel with practical and innovative abilities who shall have a good command of basic theory and professional knowledge of telecommunications, and technologies related to telecommunications systems and networks. The graduates shall be able to engage in project design, research and development, network operation, equipment manufacturing, and technical management in the field of info-communications. 2. Specialty Core Courses Editor Note: The core courses listed are only samples, not all the courses. Series courses of Circuits, Computer Networks, Signal & Linear Systems, Digital Signal Processing, Stochastic Signal Analysis, Electromagnetic Fields and Waves, Principles of Communications, and Information Theory and Coding. 3. Program Composition and Distribution of Course Hours and Credits Editor Note: The total credits for graduation are 155 points. For a Bachelor's degree in engineering, a student must achieve 18 credits in general education courses, 29.5 credits in discipline fundamental courses, 50 credits in specialty required courses, 26.5 credits in specialty elective courses, and 31 credits for the practical, amounting to a total of 155 credits. A minimum of 12 credits is required of the students for one semester except for the short summer semester. 4. Main Practical Teaching and Internship Editor Note: Students of this program are required to complete practical teaching and internship before graduation. Electronic Processing Practice; Internship; Graduation Practice; Graduation Project; Specialty Course Experiments, Course Design, etc. 6. School Introduction Editor Note: SDUST has the excellent academic performance, deep foundation of culture and a modern open environment. Shandong University of Science and Technology (SDUST), a key university of Shandong Province with distinct features, founded in 1951, is a multi-disciplinary university, offering comprehensive education in engineering, sciences, management, humanities, law, economics and education while giving prominence to engineering and the integration of science and engineering. Learn More>> About College of Chemical and Environmental Engineering There are 90 staff in the College of Chemical and Environmental Engineering, including 17 professors, 6 doctoral supervisors, 41 associate professors, 58 teachers holding doctoral diploma. It sets up the Department of Chemical Engineering, Department of Applied Chemistry, Department of Environmental Science & Engineering, Department of Biological Engineering, Department of Energy and Chemical Engineering and Basic Research Center etc. 7.
